name: MGallery Phuket V Villas
positioning: Private pool villa resort (officially V Villas Phuket - MGallery Collection) on a private hilltop above Ao Yon Bay, with a 24-hour butler for every villa
best_for: Couples who want a private pool villa with sea views
Families and groups of friends sharing a multi-bedroom villa

facts.text: The resort sits on a private hilltop.
The resort rises 39 meters above sea level with panoramic views across Ao Yon Bay.
The private pool villas come in 1, 2, 3, 4 and 6-bedroom configurations.
Floor to ceiling windows in the villas give ocean views and a seamless flow between indoor and outdoor spaces.
The 1 Bedroom Sea View Villa has an en-suite bath with twin spa baths.
The 4 Bedroom Presidential Hilltop Villa has a gourmet kitchen on the upper level and a personally-curated art gallery and wine cellar reflecting the owner's interests.
The 6 Bedroom Presidential Beachfront Villa is a three-storey villa situated closest to the beach, with its own private sauna.
The resort has an infinity pool with decks and loungers.
Yon | Ocean House serves an all-day menu inspired by European and Thai coastal cuisine.
The resort is a 15-minute drive from Phuket Old Town.
Cribs are available in the villas on request.

highlights.text: Each villa has personalised 24-hour butler service.
The 1 Bedroom Sea View Villa has a private infinity pool surrounded by wooden decks with sun loungers.
The butler can curate in-villa private dining and floating breakfast experiences.
V Villas Spa Phuket is nestled in forest canopy and offers treatments using light and Andaman pearl powders.
The 6 Bedroom Presidential Beachfront Villa has footpath access to Ao Yon Bay beach.

considerations.text: The resort is a one-hour drive from Phuket International Airport.
The 1 Bedroom Hill View Villa looks out over the forested hillside rather than the sea.
WhataHotel notes the limited number of villas may affect availability in peak seasons.
